source_text: In many African and Middle Eastern societies, it marks transition to manhood, often performed in adolescence with communal support, contrasting with the secretive, non-consensual nature of FGM, and epidemiological data show male circumcision correlates with lower HIV transmission rates in high-prevalence areas without equivalent benefits for FGM.
